criteria.statement: Dirty-tree classifier: empty porcelain output proceeds, non-empty output refuses with a reason
Branch-plan function fetches origin before creating the branch, starting from origin/main
Pipeline runner invokes data:refresh before data:build and never calls data:build after a data:refresh failure
The explicit git-add path list contains exactly the eleven documented paths and the file contains no git add -A / --all / . form
The commit-message function's output contains the run date in YYYY-MM-DD form
The push command never carries a force flag anywhere in the file
The PR-open function returns the URL its injected gh runner's stdout provides
An injected gh runner that throws makes the PR-open function reject with an error identifying PR creation as the failed step
node --test scripts/refresh-and-open-pr.test.mjs passes and never invokes a real refresh/build/git-network operation
